supplier:Clearflow Drainage Ltd.subject: Invoice CD-0912: please confirm your VAT registration number
supplier:Clearflow Drainage Ltd.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice CD-0912 dated 15 October 2026 for £198.00. The VAT registration number on it, GB 295 8417 15, does not pass HMRC's check-digit test, so the £33.00 VAT may not be reclaimable until the number is confirmed.

Could you confirm your VAT registration number, please? A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Properties Ltd

supplier:Corndell Building Supplies Ltd.subject: Statement queries: CBS-54960 and CBS-55102
supplier:Corndell Building Supplies Ltd.body:
Hello Karen,

Thank you for your statement. We have two queries before we can agree the balance.

Invoice CBS-54960, dated 28 September 2026 for £418.80, is on the statement, but we have not received it. Could you send us a copy? Invoice CBS-55102, dated 13 October 2026, shows as £264.00 on the statement, but the invoice we received is for £246.00. Could you confirm which amount is correct?

A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Properties Ltd

supplier:G Lowe Property Maintenance.subject: Invoice 0412: VAT registration number needed
supplier:G Lowe Property Maintenance.body:
Hello Gary,

Thank you for invoice 0412 dated 19 October 2026 for £408.00. It charges £68.00 VAT but does not show a VAT registration number, and we do not have one on file for you, so it is not a valid VAT invoice.

Could you send a VAT invoice showing your VAT registration number or, if you are not VAT registered, a corrected invoice without VAT? A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Properties Ltd

supplier:Sallowfield Roofing Ltd.subject: Invoice SR-1186: total does not add up
supplier:Sallowfield Roofing Ltd.body:
Hello Mark,

Thank you for invoice SR-1186 dated 9 October 2026. The net amount of £1,180.00 plus VAT of £236.00 comes to £1,416.00, but the total shown is £1,461.00, a difference of £45.00.

Could you send a corrected invoice, please? A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Properties Ltd

supplier:Willowmere Grounds Maintenance.subject: Invoice WGM-2210: change of bank details
supplier:Willowmere Grounds Maintenance.body:
Hello Tom,

We have received invoice WGM-2210, dated 2 October 2026 for £264.00, with bank details (sort code 00-98-76) that are different from the ones we hold for you.

Before any payment is made, we will phone you on the number we already hold to confirm the change. We never change bank details because of an email, so please don't send bank details by reply. If you have not changed banks, please let us know as soon as possible, and in any case by Friday 13 November.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Properties Ltd

summary: October is processed: 24 documents were read and 15 of 22 supplier invoices and credit notes are ready to import, with 7 held for a check. Willowmere Grounds Maintenance's invoice came with changed bank details, a common invoice-fraud pattern. Sallowfield Roofing's total is £45.00 more than net plus VAT, and Clearflow Drainage's VAT number fails HMRC's check. 12 items need a decision and 5 supplier emails are drafted; the supplier statement, prepayments and filing by property also need attention before month end.
